product.ta-bitsy-20.summary: The BITSY 20 could grow from a single workstation into a four-station installation.
product.ta-bitsy-20.history: The 1982 handbook places it between the BITSY 10 and 30. A single-station configuration with one standard drive was listed at DM 23,070, plus DM 2,000 for software.
product.ta-bitsy-20.technical.configurat: The standard disk provided more room for documents. The handbook specifies 1,340 KB per 8-inch drive.
product.ta-bitsy-20.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-bitsy-20.technical.limitation: The boot ROM and a working-system test remain pending.
